breakdown.description: Mercury on glass is non-wetting; assuming contact angle 0 deg is inconsistent with typical physics (it would predict rise instead of depression).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the fundamental physical inconsistency. It accepted the user's incorrect contact angle of 0 degrees for mercury on glass and proceeded to calculate a capillary rise. The ground truth correctly identifies that mercury is non-wetting, has a contact angle >90 degrees, and would cause capillary depression, not rise. The agent should have corrected this premise instead of following the flawed instruction.
